text: Illustrate the story here: The Box Pax got a big red box from his dad. "Look at this box!" Pax said to Rex. "Let's jump in it." Pax jumps in the big red box. Rex is next. "Can you help me, Pax?" said Rex. "Yes! I can help you," said Pax. Pax helps Rex get in the box. Pax and Rex jump in the box. "The box is fun!" said Pax and Rex.
